title: Marketplace discovery · new products, no history

segments.text: We operate an online marketplace. When a new product is listed, it has no clicks, reviews or purchase history. We need a way to recommend it to the right customers.
We can help with product recommendations.
But based on what? If there is no historical interaction data, how does the system know who might be interested? Recommendation accuracy is my main concern.
The documented candidate approach combines statistical learning, computer vision and predictive modelling. We need to review your product information and agree how to evaluate recommendation quality.
That sounds promising. We have product descriptions and images. Let's discuss implementation and agree the pilot evaluation criteria.
